included.goal: Replace external x25519-dalek in crates/susi-vendor-x25519-dalek with a thin #![forbid(unsafe_code)] RFC 7748 X25519 Diffie-Hellman facade backed directly by the workspace's existing curve25519-dalek 4.1.3 arithmetic (EdwardsPoint::mul_base_clamped, MontgomeryPoint::mul_clamped, and constant-time IsIdentity) and zeroize::Zeroize. Removes 3 packages — including the zeroize_derive proc-macro — from Cargo.lock (rand_core 0.6.4, x25519-dalek 2.0.1, zeroize_derive 1.5.0; Cargo.lock 185 -> 182; 173 cumulative Cargo.lock packages removed across T-CARBONLEAN-1..16) and lowers THIRD_PARTY_CEILING 99 -> 96.
included.title: Lean core: back susi-vendor-x25519-dalek directly with curve25519-dalek + zeroize (THIRD_PARTY_CEILING 99 -> 96, Cargo.lock 185 -> 182)
